title: Exercise delegation fan-in persistence across shutdown and restart
outcome: Behavior coverage proves shutdown holds an exact unsent fan-in that can later dispatch once and a persisted promoted fan-in with no proven enqueue result remains held across restart.
acceptance: Use the actual shutdown, persistence and boot paths to distinguish known unsent from unknown dispatch state after reload.
Verify that the known-unsent result reaches one provider handoff without creating a new transcript marker and the unknown result is not replayed.
